cocktails.mixingInstructions: Stir all ingredients with ice until well chilled. Strain over fresh ice in a rocks glass and garnish with a lemon twist.

cocktails.name: Seelbach
cocktails.description: A sparkling bourbon cocktail with orange liqueur and a notably generous measure of aromatic and Creole bitters.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Stir bourbon, Cointreau, and both bitters with ice. Strain into a chilled flute, top with cold sparkling wine, and garnish with an orange twist.

cocktails.name: Cantarito
cocktails.description: A Mexican tequila highball with grapefruit, orange, and lime juices, finished with grapefruit soda and a pinch of salt.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Shake tequila, citrus juices, and a pinch of salt with ice. Strain into an ice-filled highball glass, top with grapefruit soda, and stir gently. Garnish with lime.

cocktails.name: Fog Cutter
cocktails.description: A potent classic tiki drink combining rum, brandy, gin, citrus, almond orgeat, and a sherry float.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Shake rum, cognac, gin, lemon juice, orange juice, and orgeat with ice. Strain into a tall glass filled with crushed ice. Float the sherry on top and garnish with mint.

cocktails.name: Chartreuse Swizzle
cocktails.description: An herbal, tropical swizzle that balances Green Chartreuse with pineapple, lime, and spiced falernum.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Add all ingredients to a highball glass. Fill two-thirds with crushed ice and swizzle until chilled. Top with more crushed ice and garnish with mint and freshly grated nutmeg.

cocktails.name: Pisco Chilcano
cocktails.description: A light Peruvian pisco highball with lime, ginger ale, and aromatic bitters.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Build pisco and lime juice in an ice-filled highball glass. Top with ginger ale, add bitters, and stir gently. Garnish with a lime wedge.

cocktails.name: Benton's Old Fashioned
cocktails.description: A savory modern Old Fashioned made with bacon-fat-washed bourbon, maple syrup, and Angostura bitters.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Stir the bacon-fat-washed bourbon, maple syrup, and bitters with ice until chilled. Strain over a large ice cube in a rocks glass and express an orange twist over the drink.

cocktails.name: Michelada
cocktails.description: A savory Mexican beer cocktail with lime, hot sauce, Worcestershire sauce, and a lightly salted finish.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Optionally salt the rim of a chilled highball glass. Add lime juice, Worcestershire sauce, hot sauce, and a pinch of salt. Add ice if desired, pour in the cold lager, and stir gently. Garnish with lime.

cocktails.name: Hugo Spritz
cocktails.description: A floral Alpine-style spritz combining elderflower, sparkling wine, soda, mint, and lime.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Fill a wine glass with ice. Add elderflower liqueur, mint, and lime slices. Pour in Prosecco and soda water, then stir gently. Garnish with mint and lime.

cocktails.name: Brandy Milk Punch
cocktails.description: A smooth New Orleans-style milk punch with brandy, milk, sugar, and a dusting of nutmeg.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Shake cognac, milk, and simple syrup with ice until cold and frothy. Strain into a rocks glass over fresh ice and grate nutmeg over the top.

cocktails.name: Tom and Jerry
cocktails.description: A traditional warm holiday drink made with a whipped egg-and-sugar batter, rum, brandy, hot milk, and nutmeg.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Whisk the egg yolk with the sugar until pale. In a separate bowl, beat the egg white to soft peaks and fold it into the yolk mixture. Divide the batter between warmed mugs, add cognac and rum, then top with hot milk while stirring. Garnish generously with nutmeg. Use pasteurized eggs if preferred.

cocktails.name: Carajillo
cocktails.description: A Spanish coffee cocktail pairing espresso with vanilla-citrus Licor 43, commonly served over ice.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Fill a rocks glass with ice. Add Licor 43 and freshly pulled espresso, then stir briefly to combine.

cocktails.name: Negroni Sbagliato
cocktails.description: A sparkling, lower-proof variation on the Negroni that replaces gin with sparkling wine while keeping the bittersweet Campari and vermouth core.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Build Campari and sweet vermouth over ice in a wine glass. Top with sparkling wine and stir gently. Garnish with an orange slice.

cocktails.name: Campari Spritz
cocktails.description: A bright, bittersweet spritz with Campari, sparkling wine, and soda.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Fill a wine glass with ice. Add Campari and sparkling wine, top with soda, and stir gently. Garnish with an orange slice.

cocktails.name: Elderflower Spritz
cocktails.description: A floral, lightly sweet spritz that pairs elderflower liqueur with sparkling wine and soda.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Fill a wine glass with ice. Add elderflower liqueur and sparkling wine, top with soda, and stir gently. Garnish with an orange slice.

cocktails.name: Salty Dog
cocktails.description: A tart grapefruit highball traditionally served with a salted rim; gin gives it botanical depth, while vodka makes it cleaner.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Rim a highball glass with salt and fill with ice. Add gin or vodka and grapefruit juice, then stir. Garnish with a grapefruit wedge.

cocktails.name: Cape Codder
cocktails.description: A simple vodka and cranberry highball with a crisp, tart berry profile.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Build vodka and cranberry juice over ice in a highball glass. Stir and garnish with a lime wedge.

cocktails.name: Madras
cocktails.description: A fruit-forward vodka highball combining tart cranberry with sweet orange juice.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Build vodka, cranberry juice, and orange juice over ice in a highball glass. Stir gently and garnish with an orange wedge.

cocktails.name: Kamikaze
cocktails.description: A sharp, citrus-forward cocktail made with equal parts vodka, orange liqueur, and lime juice.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Shake vodka, triple sec, and lime juice with ice. Strain into a chilled coupe and garnish with a lime wheel.

cocktails.name: Vodka Martini
cocktails.description: A clean, spirit-forward martini made with vodka and dry vermouth, garnished with a lemon twist or olive.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Stir vodka and dry vermouth with ice until very cold. Strain into a chilled martini glass and garnish with a lemon twist or olive.

cocktails.name: Scotch & Soda
cocktails.description: A simple Scotch highball that opens up the whisky with chilled soda water.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Fill a highball glass with ice. Add Scotch and top with soda water. Stir gently and garnish with a lemon twist.

cocktails.name: Mamie Taylor
cocktails.description: A Scotch-based buck with lime and spicy ginger beer, refreshing with a smoky malt backbone.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Build Scotch and lime juice over ice in a highball glass. Top with ginger beer, stir gently, and garnish with lime.

cocktails.name: Presbyterian
cocktails.description: A balanced whiskey highball softened with ginger ale and lengthened with soda water.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Build whiskey over ice in a highball glass. Add ginger ale and soda water, stir gently, and garnish with lemon.

cocktails.name: Horse’s Neck
cocktails.description: A brandy highball known for its long spiral of lemon peel and refreshing ginger-ale base.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Coil a long lemon peel inside a highball glass and fill with ice. Add brandy and bitters, top with ginger ale, and stir gently.

cocktails.name: Yellow Bird
cocktails.description: A golden tropical sour combining rum, orange liqueur, Galliano, and lime.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Shake all ingredients with ice. Strain into a chilled coupe and garnish with an orange slice.

cocktails.name: Tequila Matador
cocktails.description: A simple tequila and pineapple sour brightened with fresh lime juice.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Shake tequila, pineapple juice, and lime juice with ice. Strain into a chilled coupe or over fresh ice. Garnish with pineapple.

cocktails.name: Sherry Sour
cocktails.description: A lighter-bodied sour that pairs nutty, oxidative sherry with lemon and a soft egg-white texture.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Dry-shake all ingredients without ice, then shake again with ice. Strain into a chilled coupe and garnish with a lemon twist.

cocktails.name: Tinto de Verano
cocktails.description: A Spanish summer drink of red wine and a sparkling, lightly sweetened mixer. This version uses soda water and simple syrup because lemon soda is not in the current ingredient list.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Fill a wine glass with ice. Add red wine and simple syrup, top with soda water, stir gently, and garnish with lemon.

cocktails.name: Sangria
cocktails.description: A fruit-forward wine punch with brandy, citrus, fresh fruit, and a splash of soda.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Combine red wine, brandy, orange juice, simple syrup, orange slices, and grapes in a pitcher. Chill for at least an hour. Add soda water just before serving over ice.

cocktails.name: Golden Cadillac
cocktails.description: A rich dessert cocktail blending herbal-vanilla Galliano with chocolate liqueur and cream.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Shake Galliano, crème de cacao, and cream with ice until well chilled. Strain into a chilled coupe and garnish with grated nutmeg.

cocktails.name: Brandy Smash
cocktails.description: A minty smash that brings brandy together with simple syrup and fresh mint over ice.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Gently muddle mint with simple syrup in a rocks glass. Add brandy and crushed ice, stir until chilled, and garnish with a mint sprig.

cocktails.name: Gin Daisy
cocktails.description: A refreshing gin sour sweetened with grenadine and lengthened with soda water.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Shake gin, lemon juice, and grenadine with ice. Strain into an ice-filled highball glass, top with soda water, and stir gently.

cocktails.name: Boston Sour
cocktails.description: A whiskey sour with egg white, creating a silky foam and softer texture.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Dry-shake all ingredients without ice, then shake again with ice. Strain into a chilled coupe and garnish with a few drops of bitters if desired.

cocktails.name: Mexican Mule
cocktails.description: A tequila-based mule that combines agave character, fresh lime, and spicy ginger beer.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Build tequila and lime juice over ice in a highball glass. Top with ginger beer, stir gently, and garnish with lime.

cocktails.name: East India Cocktail
cocktails.description: A vintage brandy cocktail with pineapple, maraschino, and bitters, giving it a lightly tropical aromatic profile.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Shake all ingredients with ice until chilled. Fine-strain into a chilled coupe and garnish with a lemon twist.

cocktails.name: Floradora
cocktails.description: A classic gin highball with raspberry, lime, and spicy ginger beer.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Shake gin, lime juice, and raspberry syrup with ice. Strain into an ice-filled highball glass, top with ginger beer, stir gently, and garnish.

cocktails.name: Silver Fizz
cocktails.description: A gin fizz variation with egg white for a silky texture and foamy head.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Dry-shake gin, lemon juice, syrup, and egg white. Add ice and shake again until chilled. Strain into a highball glass and top slowly with soda water.

cocktails.name: Royal Fizz
cocktails.description: A gin fizz variation made with a whole egg, giving the drink a richer body than a standard fizz.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Shake gin, lemon juice, syrup, and whole egg vigorously with ice. Strain into a highball glass and top carefully with soda water.

cocktails.name: Chicago Cocktail
cocktails.description: A brandy cocktail accented with orange liqueur, bitters, and absinthe; some versions use a sugared rim.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Stir brandy, triple sec, and bitters with ice until chilled. Rinse a chilled coupe with absinthe, discard excess, strain in the drink, and garnish.

cocktails.name: Deauville Cocktail
cocktails.description: A brandy sour combining Cognac, Calvados, orange liqueur, and lemon.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Shake all ingredients with ice until chilled. Strain into a chilled coupe and garnish with a lemon twist.

cocktails.name: Brandy Cobbler
cocktails.description: A historic crushed-ice drink made by sweetening brandy and muddling it with citrus, then decorating it with seasonal fruit.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Gently muddle orange wedges and sugar in a tall glass. Add brandy and crushed ice; churn until cold. Top with more crushed ice and garnish with fruit and mint.

cocktails.name: Black Velvet
cocktails.description: The classic combination of stout and Champagne, pairing roasted malt with dry sparkling wine.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Pour chilled stout into a flute. Slowly top with chilled Champagne, pouring gently to preserve carbonation.

cocktails.name: Greenpoint
cocktails.description: A Manhattan relative combining rye and sweet vermouth with the herbal complexity of Yellow Chartreuse.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Stir all ingredients with ice until thoroughly chilled. Strain into a chilled coupe and garnish with a lemon twist.

cocktails.name: Monte Cassino
cocktails.description: A modern herbal sour pairing rye with Bénédictine, Yellow Chartreuse, and fresh lemon.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Shake all ingredients with ice until chilled. Fine-strain into a chilled coupe and garnish with a lemon twist.

cocktails.name: Industry Sour
cocktails.description: An intensely herbal, bittersweet sour built from equal parts Fernet-Branca, Green Chartreuse, lime, and syrup.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Shake all ingredients with ice until very cold. Fine-strain into a chilled coupe.

cocktails.name: Siesta
cocktails.description: A modern tequila sour with grapefruit, lime, and Campari, balancing acidity with a bitter finish.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Shake all ingredients with ice until chilled. Strain into a chilled coupe and garnish with a grapefruit twist.

cocktails.name: Bourbon Rickey
cocktails.description: A dry, refreshing highball pairing bourbon with fresh lime and soda, without added sugar.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Build bourbon and lime juice in an ice-filled highball glass. Top with soda water, stir gently, and garnish with a lime wedge.

cocktails.name: Gin Toddy
cocktails.description: A warming gin toddy combining honey, lemon, hot water, and botanical aromas.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Add gin, honey syrup, and lemon juice to a heatproof mug. Top with hot water and stir. Garnish with lemon.

cocktails.name: Golden Dream
cocktails.description: A creamy orange dessert cocktail with Galliano vanilla and herbal notes.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Shake all ingredients vigorously with ice until cold and lightly frothy. Strain into a chilled coupe and garnish with orange.

cocktails.name: Orgasm
cocktails.description: A sweet, creamy dessert cocktail combining almond-flavored amaretto and coffee liqueur.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Shake all ingredients with ice until thoroughly chilled. Strain into a chilled coupe and finish with grated nutmeg.

cocktails.name: Port Flip
cocktails.description: A rich historic flip combining fortified wine, brandy, and egg yolk for a velvety texture.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Dry-shake all ingredients vigorously, then add ice and shake again until very cold. Fine-strain into a chilled coupe and grate nutmeg over the surface.

cocktails.name: Coffee Cocktail
cocktails.description: A classic port-and-brandy cocktail whose traditional recipe contains no coffee despite its name.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Shake all ingredients vigorously with ice until cold and frothy. Fine-strain into a chilled coupe and garnish with freshly grated nutmeg.

cocktails.name: Rum Runner
cocktails.description: A fruity tropical rum cocktail with banana liqueur, blackberry liqueur, passion fruit, and citrus.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Shake all ingredients with ice until chilled. Strain into a hurricane glass filled with crushed ice and garnish with orange.

cocktails.name: Cobra Fang
cocktails.description: A complex tiki-style rum drink combining citrus, passion fruit, falernum, and a hint of absinthe.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Shake all ingredients with ice until chilled. Strain into a hurricane glass filled with crushed ice. Garnish with mint and lime.

cocktails.name: Champagne Julep
cocktails.description: A celebratory julep variation combining bourbon and mint with sparkling wine.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Gently press mint with simple syrup in a julep cup. Add bourbon and crushed ice, stir briefly, then top with chilled Champagne and garnish with mint.

cocktails.name: Blackberry Bramble
cocktails.description: A berry-forward variation on the Bramble, layering blackberry liqueur over a crisp gin and lemon sour.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Shake gin, lemon juice, and simple syrup with ice. Strain over crushed ice in a rocks glass. Drizzle crème de mûre over the top and garnish.

cocktails.name: Pisco Elderflower Sour
cocktails.description: A floral pisco sour variation softened by elderflower liqueur and silky egg-white foam.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Dry-shake all ingredients without ice. Add ice and shake again until chilled. Fine-strain into a chilled coupe.

cocktails.name: Elderflower Collins
cocktails.description: A floral Collins variation pairing gin and elderflower liqueur with lemon and soda.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Shake gin, elderflower liqueur, and lemon juice with ice. Strain into an ice-filled highball glass, top with soda, stir gently, and garnish.

cocktails.name: Amaretto Stone Sour
cocktails.description: A fruity amaretto sour variation brightened with orange juice for a softer citrus profile.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Shake all ingredients with ice until chilled. Strain over fresh ice in a rocks glass and garnish with an orange slice.

cocktails.name: Pimm’s Summer Cup
cocktails.description: A refreshing summer cup built around Pimm’s, fizzy ginger ale, citrus, and mint.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Add Pimm’s to an ice-filled highball glass. Add orange and lime, top with ginger ale, stir gently, and garnish with mint.

cocktails.name: Amontillado Cobbler
cocktails.description: A sherry cobbler variation showcasing Amontillado’s nutty character with muddled orange and crushed ice.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Gently muddle orange wedges with simple syrup in a tall glass. Add sherry and crushed ice, churn until chilled, and garnish with orange and grapes.

cocktails.name: Cynar Julep
cocktails.description: A bitter, herbal julep variation using Cynar in place of whiskey, with mint and crushed ice softening its bittersweet character.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Gently press mint with simple syrup in a julep cup. Add Cynar and crushed ice, churn until frosty, top with more crushed ice, and garnish with mint.

cocktails.name: Amaro Highball
cocktails.description: A simple long drink combining herbal amaro bitterness with sweet, spicy ginger ale and a touch of lemon.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Build amaro and lemon juice over ice in a highball glass. Top with ginger ale, stir gently, and garnish with lemon.

cocktails.name: Licor 43 Cortado
cocktails.description: A coffee-forward Licor 43 drink inspired by Spanish carajillo and cortado flavors, balancing vanilla sweetness with espresso and milk.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Add Licor 43 and espresso to a small ice-filled rocks glass. Stir briefly, add milk, and serve.

cocktails.name: Cameron’s Kick
cocktails.description: A whiskey sour that blends Scotch and Irish whiskey, with almond orgeat smoothing the malt and lemon adding a bright edge.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Shake both whiskies, lemon juice, and orgeat with ice until chilled. Strain into a chilled coupe and garnish with a lemon twist.

cocktails.name: Tuxedo No. 2
cocktails.description: A complex gin martini variation with dry vermouth, maraschino, absinthe, and orange bitters adding herbal, anise, and citrus notes.
cocktails.mixingInstructions: Stir gin, dry vermouth, maraschino liqueur, absinthe, and orange bitters with ice until very cold. Strain into a chilled coupe and garnish with a lemon twist.

ingredients.name: Gin
ingredients.description: A botanical spirit, usually flavored with juniper, citrus peel, and herbs. Styles range from crisp and piney to floral or citrus-forward.

ingredients.name: Vodka
ingredients.description: A relatively neutral distilled spirit that adds alcohol and body without a strong flavor of its own.

ingredients.name: Tequila
ingredients.description: A Mexican spirit distilled from blue agave. It can taste peppery, herbal, earthy, citrusy, or lightly sweet.

ingredients.name: Bourbon
ingredients.description: American whiskey made with at least 51% corn and aged in new charred oak barrels; commonly brings vanilla, caramel, and oak notes.

ingredients.name: Rye Whiskey
ingredients.description: Whiskey made with a substantial proportion of rye grain, often giving it a spicy, dry, peppery character.

ingredients.name: Irish Whiskey
ingredients.description: Whiskey made in Ireland, often smooth and lightly fruity or malty; styles vary by producer and distillation method.

ingredients.name: Scotch Whisky
ingredients.description: Whisky made in Scotland. Flavor ranges from light and malty to rich, smoky, or peaty depending on style.

ingredients.name: Cognac
ingredients.description: A grape brandy from the Cognac region of France, typically offering dried fruit, oak, spice, and floral notes.

ingredients.name: Pisco
ingredients.description: A grape spirit associated with Peru and Chile. It is often aromatic, with fresh grape and floral flavors.

ingredients.name: Cachaça
ingredients.description: A Brazilian spirit distilled from fresh sugarcane juice, with grassy, fruity, and sometimes earthy notes.

ingredients.name: Cointreau
ingredients.description: A clear French orange liqueur with a balanced sweet-bitter citrus flavor; a specific brand of triple sec.

ingredients.name: Triple Sec
ingredients.description: A sweet orange-flavored liqueur. Brands vary in sweetness and intensity; it is commonly used in citrus cocktails.

ingredients.name: Orange Curaçao
ingredients.description: An orange liqueur in the curaçao style, often with a rich citrus-peel flavor; it may be clear or colored.

ingredients.name: Amaretto
ingredients.description: A sweet Italian-style liqueur with almond-like, marzipan, and stone-fruit-kernel flavors.

ingredients.name: Coffee Liqueur
ingredients.description: A sweet liqueur flavored with coffee. Brands differ in roast intensity, sweetness, and alcohol strength.

ingredients.name: Drambuie
ingredients.description: A Scotch whisky liqueur sweetened with honey and flavored with herbs and spices.

ingredients.name: Bénédictine
ingredients.description: A French herbal liqueur with honeyed, warming spice and botanical notes.

ingredients.name: Fernet-Branca
ingredients.description: An intensely bitter Italian-style amaro with minty, medicinal, and herbal flavors; usually used in small amounts.

ingredients.name: Green Chartreuse
ingredients.description: A high-proof French herbal liqueur made from a complex blend of botanicals; powerful, minty, piney, and sweet-bitter.

ingredients.name: Crème de Violette
ingredients.description: A floral liqueur flavored with violets, usually purple and lightly sweet.

ingredients.name: Maraschino Liqueur
ingredients.description: A clear, dry-ish cherry liqueur made from marasca cherries and their pits; floral and almond-like rather than syrupy.

ingredients.name: Peach Schnapps
ingredients.description: A sweet peach-flavored liqueur, generally used to add ripe fruit flavor and sweetness.

ingredients.name: Passion Fruit Liqueur
ingredients.description: A sweet-tart liqueur flavored with passion fruit; useful when a recipe needs both tropical aroma and sweetness.

ingredients.name: Absinthe
ingredients.description: A potent anise- and fennel-flavored spirit with herbal bitterness. Often used in small measures or as a glass rinse.

ingredients.name: Falernum
ingredients.description: A sweet Caribbean cocktail syrup or liqueur flavored with lime, ginger, clove, and often almond. Check the bottle because alcoholic and nonalcoholic versions exist.

ingredients.name: Dry Vermouth
ingredients.description: A dry, aromatic fortified wine flavored with herbs and botanicals; adds herbal complexity without much sweetness.

ingredients.name: Sweet Vermouth
ingredients.description: A sweetened, botanically flavored fortified wine, often red or amber, with notes of spice, herbs, and dried fruit.

ingredients.name: Lillet Blanc
ingredients.description: A French aromatized wine aperitif with citrus, floral, and gentle bitter notes; often used in place of or alongside vermouth.

ingredients.name: Champagne
ingredients.description: Sparkling wine from the Champagne region of France. It is typically dry and adds bubbles, acidity, and toasty or citrus notes.

ingredients.name: Prosecco
ingredients.description: Italian sparkling wine, usually fruity, floral, and fresh; often used in spritzes.

ingredients.name: Dry Red Wine
ingredients.description: A red wine with little noticeable residual sugar. In cocktails, use a wine whose flavor you enjoy drinking on its own.

ingredients.name: Angostura Bitters
ingredients.description: Concentrated aromatic bitters with baking-spice, clove, and herbal notes; a few dashes can add depth to a drink.

ingredients.name: Peychaud's Bitters
ingredients.description: A bright, gently bitter New Orleans-style aromatic bitters with anise and floral notes, traditionally used in a Sazerac.

ingredients.name: Lemon Juice
ingredients.description: Freshly squeezed lemon juice adds sharp acidity and bright citrus flavor. Fresh juice is generally best in cocktails.

ingredients.name: Lime Juice
ingredients.description: Freshly squeezed lime juice adds tart, aromatic citrus flavor, especially in sours and tropical drinks.

ingredients.name: Grapefruit Juice
ingredients.description: Juice with a bittersweet citrus flavor; sweetness and bitterness vary by grapefruit and brand.

ingredients.name: Orange Juice
ingredients.description: Orange juice adds sweet citrus flavor and body. Fresh juice is often brighter, while packaged juice is more consistent.

ingredients.name: Cranberry Juice
ingredients.description: Tart red berry juice. Cocktail cranberry drinks are often sweetened, so check whether the recipe expects sweetened or unsweetened juice.

ingredients.name: Pineapple Juice
ingredients.description: Sweet-tart tropical juice that adds fruit flavor, acidity, and body; shaking can create a foamy texture.

ingredients.name: Tomato Juice
ingredients.description: Savory, mildly acidic juice used in drinks such as the Bloody Mary.

ingredients.name: Passion Fruit Purée
ingredients.description: Thick puréed passion fruit with intense tropical aroma and tartness. Sweetened products vary, so adjust syrup if needed.

ingredients.name: White Peach Purée
ingredients.description: Smooth purée of white peaches, adding delicate peach aroma, fruit sweetness, and body.

ingredients.name: Simple Syrup
ingredients.description: A basic mixture of sugar dissolved in water, used to sweeten cocktails without undissolved crystals. Strength varies by recipe.

ingredients.name: Agave Syrup
ingredients.description: A pourable sweetener made from agave, with a mild flavor; commonly paired with tequila and other agave spirits.

ingredients.name: Brown Sugar
ingredients.description: Sugar containing molasses, adding sweetness with a light caramel and toffee note.

ingredients.name: Cinnamon Syrup
ingredients.description: Sugar syrup infused with cinnamon, providing warm baking-spice flavor without needing dry spice in the glass.

ingredients.name: Grenadine
ingredients.description: A red sweet-tart syrup traditionally made from pomegranate; commercial versions vary, so check the label for fruit content.

ingredients.name: Honey Syrup
ingredients.description: Honey diluted with water so it mixes easily into cold drinks. Honey flavor and sweetness vary by type and ratio.

ingredients.name: Honey-Ginger Syrup
ingredients.description: A cocktail syrup combining honey sweetness with fresh, warming ginger flavor.

ingredients.name: Orgeat
ingredients.description: A sweet almond syrup, often with orange-flower water. It adds nutty, floral richness to tiki and other cocktails.

ingredients.name: Raspberry Syrup
ingredients.description: Sweet syrup flavored with raspberries, adding berry aroma, color, and sweetness.

ingredients.name: Vanilla Syrup
ingredients.description: Sugar syrup flavored with vanilla, lending a soft, fragrant sweetness.

ingredients.name: Sugar
ingredients.description: Granulated sugar used for sweetness or muddling. It dissolves more readily when shaken with liquid or made into syrup.

ingredients.name: Soda Water
ingredients.description: Plain carbonated water that lengthens a drink without adding sweetness or strong flavor.

ingredients.name: Tonic Water
ingredients.description: Carbonated mixer flavored with quinine and usually sweetened; its characteristic bitterness pairs well with spirits.

ingredients.name: Ginger Beer
ingredients.description: A strongly flavored ginger mixer with a spicy bite. Most modern cocktail ginger beers are nonalcoholic.

ingredients.name: Grapefruit Soda
ingredients.description: Sweetened carbonated grapefruit drink, adding citrus bitterness, sweetness, and bubbles; brands differ in bitterness.

ingredients.name: Cola
ingredients.description: Sweet, caramel-colored carbonated soft drink with a familiar vanilla-spice profile.

ingredients.name: Espresso
ingredients.description: A concentrated coffee shot with roasted flavor and crema; it adds coffee intensity and can help create foam when shaken.

ingredients.name: Hot Coffee
ingredients.description: Brewed coffee served hot, used as the base for warm coffee cocktails.

ingredients.name: Cream
ingredients.description: Dairy cream adds richness and a smooth texture. Fat percentage affects how rich the drink feels and how it mixes.

ingredients.name: Coconut Cream
ingredients.description: Thick, rich coconut cream that adds coconut flavor and body; usually unsweetened unless the label says otherwise.

ingredients.name: Egg White
ingredients.description: Egg white adds a silky texture and foamy head when shaken. Use pasteurized egg white if raw egg is a concern.

ingredients.name: Mint
ingredients.description: Fresh mint leaves add cool, fragrant herbal notes. Gently press or slap the leaves to release aroma without shredding them.

ingredients.name: Worcestershire Sauce
ingredients.description: A savory fermented condiment with tangy, salty, sweet, and umami flavors; often used in Bloody Mary-style drinks.

ingredients.name: Hot Sauce
ingredients.description: A chili-based sauce that adds heat and acidity. Spice level and vinegar flavor vary by brand.

ingredients.name: Salt and Pepper
ingredients.description: A seasoning combination used to add savory balance and a little heat, especially in tomato-based cocktails.

ingredients.name: Aperol
ingredients.description: A bright orange Italian aperitif with bittersweet orange and herbal flavors; lower in bitterness and alcohol than many amari.

ingredients.name: Campari
ingredients.description: A vivid red Italian bitter aperitif with pronounced bitter orange, herbs, and spice.

ingredients.name: Islay Scotch
ingredients.description: Scotch whisky from Islay, often known for smoky peat, sea-spray, medicinal, and earthy notes, though styles vary.

ingredients.name: Blended Scotch
ingredients.description: Scotch whisky blended from different malt and grain whiskies; flavor is generally designed for balance and consistency.

ingredients.name: Aged Rum
ingredients.description: Rum aged in barrels, usually developing vanilla, caramel, oak, and dried-fruit notes.

ingredients.name: Dark Rum
ingredients.description: A dark-colored rum style often associated with deeper molasses, caramel, and spice notes; color alone does not reliably indicate age.

ingredients.name: Overproof Rum
ingredients.description: Rum bottled at a higher-than-usual alcohol strength. It adds intense rum flavor and potency, so measure carefully.

ingredients.name: White Rum
ingredients.description: Clear rum, usually light and clean in flavor, commonly used in daiquiris and other citrus-forward drinks.

ingredients.name: Citron Vodka
ingredients.description: Vodka flavored with lemon or other citrus, adding a subtle citrus aroma without the acidity of juice.

ingredients.name: Vanilla Vodka
ingredients.description: Vodka flavored with vanilla, adding sweet, dessert-like aroma; sweetness varies by brand.

ingredients.name: Reposado Tequila
ingredients.description: Tequila aged in oak for at least two months but less than a year, combining agave character with gentle oak and vanilla notes.

ingredients.name: Sparkling Wine
ingredients.description: A general term for wine with bubbles, including styles beyond Champagne and Prosecco. Dryness and flavor depend on the bottle.

ingredients.name: Lime
ingredients.description: A whole lime used for wedges, wheels, zest, or garnish; unlike lime juice, it may be included mainly for aroma and presentation.

ingredients.name: Aromatic Bitters
ingredients.description: Concentrated bitters with layered spice and herbal flavors. Use drops or dashes to season a cocktail rather than as a main ingredient.

ingredients.name: Crème de Cacao
ingredients.description: A sweet chocolate-flavored liqueur, available in white or dark versions; often used in dessert cocktails.

ingredients.name: Olive Brine
ingredients.description: The salty, savory liquid from a jar of olives, used to give drinks such as a Dirty Martini a briny flavor.

ingredients.name: Hot Water
ingredients.description: Hot water used to dilute and warm a drink, especially hot toddies and other winter cocktails.

ingredients.name: Basil
ingredients.description: Fresh basil leaves bring sweet, peppery, clove-like herbal aroma, often paired with citrus and fruit.

ingredients.name: Crème de Mûre
ingredients.description: A French blackberry liqueur with deep berry flavor and sweetness; commonly paired with gin or sparkling wine.

ingredients.name: Cherry Liqueur
ingredients.description: A liqueur flavored with cherries. Sweetness and style vary widely, from rich cherry to drier, more spirituous versions.

ingredients.name: Amaro
ingredients.description: An Italian-style bittersweet herbal liqueur, usually served as a digestif or used to add botanical complexity. Each brand tastes different.

ingredients.name: Crème de Cassis
ingredients.description: A sweet, dark-red blackcurrant liqueur with concentrated berry flavor, traditionally mixed with white wine or sparkling wine.

ingredients.name: Orange Flower Water
ingredients.description: A highly aromatic distillation of orange blossoms. Use sparingly: a few drops can add a floral citrus perfume.

ingredients.name: Crème de Menthe
ingredients.description: A sweet mint liqueur, available in clear or green versions, with a strong cooling mint flavor.

ingredients.name: Cream Liqueur
ingredients.description: A sweet liqueur made with dairy cream or a cream-like base, often flavored with whiskey, chocolate, coffee, or vanilla.

ingredients.name: Apple Brandy
ingredients.description: Brandy distilled from apples or apple cider, with baked-apple, orchard-fruit, and sometimes oak notes.

ingredients.name: Sloe Gin
ingredients.description: A gin-based liqueur infused with sloe berries, giving it a deep red color and tart, almond-like berry flavor.

ingredients.name: Strawberry Purée
ingredients.description: Puréed strawberries that add fresh berry flavor, color, and body; sweetness varies with the fruit.

ingredients.name: Mango Purée
ingredients.description: Thick puréed mango with tropical sweetness and a soft texture; ripe fruit can vary substantially in sweetness.

ingredients.name: Crushed Ice
ingredients.description: Small pieces of ice that chill quickly and dilute a drink faster than large cubes; common in swizzles and tiki cocktails.

ingredients.name: Galliano
ingredients.description: A golden Italian herbal liqueur with vanilla, anise, and spice notes, recognizable in the Harvey Wallbanger.

ingredients.name: Apricot Brandy
ingredients.description: An apricot-flavored spirit or liqueur. Some versions are sweet liqueurs; others are drier fruit brandies, so check the bottle.

ingredients.name: Yellow Chartreuse
ingredients.description: A lower-proof herbal liqueur from the Chartreuse tradition, with honeyed sweetness and softer floral, spice, and herb notes than Green Chartreuse.

ingredients.name: Cynar
ingredients.description: A bittersweet Italian amaro flavored primarily with artichoke and other botanicals; earthy, herbal, and less intensely bitter than some amari.

ingredients.name: Orange Bitters
ingredients.description: Concentrated bitters highlighting orange peel and spice, used in small dashes to brighten and season cocktails.

ingredients.name: Celery Bitters
ingredients.description: Savory, vegetal bitters with celery and herbal notes; useful in gin, tequila, and tomato-based drinks.

ingredients.name: Amontillado Sherry
ingredients.description: A dry, amber Spanish fortified wine with nutty, savory, and gently oxidative flavors.

ingredients.name: Dry Sherry
ingredients.description: A broad term for dry Spanish fortified wine. Flavor can range from delicate and saline to rich and nutty, depending on style.

ingredients.name: Port Wine
ingredients.description: A Portuguese fortified wine, usually rich and sweet with dark-fruit flavors; styles range from ruby to tawny.

ingredients.name: Egg Yolk
ingredients.description: Egg yolk adds richness, body, and a custard-like texture. Use pasteurized yolk if raw egg is a concern.

ingredients.name: Demerara Syrup
ingredients.description: Syrup made with demerara or similar raw cane sugar, bringing deeper molasses and toffee notes than plain simple syrup.

ingredients.name: Allspice Dram
ingredients.description: A sweet Jamaican-style liqueur made with allspice berries, offering clove, cinnamon, and nutmeg-like warmth.

ingredients.name: Mezcal
ingredients.description: A Mexican spirit made from agave; many styles have smoky, earthy, mineral, or roasted-agave flavors, though not all are heavily smoky.

ingredients.name: Jamaican Rum
ingredients.description: Rum from Jamaica, often pot-distilled and notably fruity or funky, with ripe banana, tropical fruit, and sometimes fermented notes.

ingredients.name: Martinique Rhum
ingredients.description: Rhum from Martinique, often made from fresh sugarcane juice (rhum agricole) with grassy, vegetal, and earthy flavors.

ingredients.name: Cream of Coconut
ingredients.description: A sweetened, thick coconut product designed for drinks and desserts. It is much sweeter than unsweetened coconut cream.

ingredients.name: Dry White Wine
ingredients.description: A white wine with little residual sugar. Choose a clean, crisp wine unless the recipe suggests a particular style.

ingredients.name: Orange
ingredients.description: Fresh orange used for wedges, wheels, peel, or zest. The peel provides fragrant oils; the fruit adds juicy citrus sweetness.

ingredients.name: Grapes
ingredients.description: Fresh grapes used as a garnish or muddled for mild, juicy fruit sweetness.

ingredients.name: Calvados
ingredients.description: Apple brandy from Normandy, France, often aged in oak and flavored with orchard fruit, spice, and wood.

ingredients.name: Amer Picon
ingredients.description: A French bittersweet orange aperitif with citrus and quinine-like bitterness. The original can be difficult to find, and substitutes may differ.

ingredients.name: Pimm's No. 1
ingredients.description: A British gin-based fruit-and-herb liqueur with a relatively low alcohol strength and a bittersweet, spiced character; traditionally lengthened with lemonade.

ingredients.name: Suze Gentian Liqueur
ingredients.description: A French gentian liqueur with a distinctive earthy, rooty bitterness and citrus-herbal notes.

ingredients.name: Ginger Ale
ingredients.description: A sweet, gently ginger-flavored carbonated mixer. It is usually milder and less spicy than ginger beer.

ingredients.name: Maple Syrup
ingredients.description: Syrup made by concentrating maple tree sap, adding distinctive woodsy, caramel-like sweetness.

ingredients.name: Oloroso Sherry
ingredients.description: A rich, dry Spanish fortified wine aged with exposure to oxygen, giving it deep nutty, toasted, and dried-fruit flavors.

ingredients.name: Elderflower Liqueur
ingredients.description: A fragrant, sweet liqueur made with elderflowers, often showing floral, pear, and citrus notes.

ingredients.name: Whole Milk
ingredients.description: Milk with its natural fat content, adding a lighter dairy texture than cream; used in milk punches and creamy cocktails.

ingredients.name: Lager Beer
ingredients.description: A crisp, fermented beer style with a clean malt flavor and carbonation; use a straightforward lager unless the recipe specifies otherwise.

ingredients.name: Bacon Fat-Washed Bourbon
ingredients.description: Bourbon infused with bacon fat and then chilled and filtered to remove the solid fat, leaving savory, smoky notes. It is a prepared ingredient rather than a standard bottled spirit.

ingredients.name: Licor 43
ingredients.description: A Spanish golden liqueur with a sweet vanilla-forward flavor and citrus and spice notes; often paired with coffee.

ingredients.name: Brandy
ingredients.description: A broad category of distilled fruit spirits, commonly grape-based, with flavors ranging from fresh fruit to dried fruit, oak, and spice.

ingredients.name: Stout
ingredients.description: A dark, roasted beer with flavors that can include coffee, cocoa, toast, and caramel.

ingredients.name: Crème de Banane
ingredients.description: A sweet banana liqueur used in tropical and tiki cocktails.

ingredients.name: Whole Egg
ingredients.description: A whole chicken egg used in some classic cocktails to add richness, body, and foam.

families.label: Sours
families.description: Cocktails built around a spirit, citrus, and a sweetening component.

families.label: Highballs
families.description: Spirit-forward drinks lengthened with a larger quantity of a non-alcoholic or lightly alcoholic mixer.

families.label: Old-Fashioned
families.description: Spirit-forward cocktails built around a base spirit, sweetener, and bitters.

families.label: Martinis
families.description: Spirit-forward cocktails based on a spirit combined with fortified or aromatized wine and related modifiers.

families.label: Manhattan-Style
families.description: Spirit-and-vermouth cocktails related to the Manhattan family.

families.label: Margarita-Style
families.description: Tequila- or agave-spirit cocktails combining citrus and orange liqueur or a related sweetener.

families.label: Tiki
families.description: Rum-forward tropical cocktails typically combining multiple spirits, citrus, fruit, syrups, or other flavorful ingredients.

families.label: Fizzes
families.description: Cocktails incorporating citrus, sweetener, and carbonated water, often with a spirit base.

families.label: Juleps
families.description: Spirit-forward cocktails built around fresh mint and sugar, traditionally served over crushed ice.

families.label: Smashes
families.description: Short cocktails combining spirit, fresh herbs or fruit, and sweetener, generally served over ice.

families.label: Spritzes
families.description: Low- to moderate-alcohol drinks combining an aperitif or fortified wine with sparkling wine and/or soda.

families.label: Flips
families.description: Rich cocktails incorporating a whole egg or egg yolk with a spirit and sweetener.

families.label: Punches
families.description: Larger-format drinks combining spirits with citrus, sugar, water, tea, wine, or other mixers.

families.label: Toddies
families.description: Warm drinks combining a spirit with hot water and sweetener, often with spices or citrus.
